description: This source file defines extension methods for the MemoryPool<byte> class, providing utility methods to compute minimum segment and allocation sizes.

classes.name: MemoryPoolExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for computing minimum segment and allocation sizes for MemoryPool<byte>.

methods.name: GetMinimumSegmentSize
methods.description: Computes a minimum segment size for the specified MemoryPool<byte> instance, defaulting to 4096 if the pool is null.

methods.name: GetMinimumAllocSize
methods.description: Computes a minimum allocation size, defined as half of the minimum segment size.
